forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,13 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: Give the parallel git tests a time limit that a loaded CI runner can meet
+---
+CI run 44343306842 (909c903, runner m3u1, 32 cores) failed in `GitProcessTests.sleepWakesWhileGitRuns` with `.timedOut`. The test starts 128 `sleep 5` git commands while the other suites run. The time limit of `GitProcess.run` starts before git starts, so it also counts the wait for a thread and the start of the process. Alone, the test passes in 5.3 s. This is a limit that is too tight under load, not a defect in `GitProcess`.
+
+## Steps
+- [x] The two parallel tests use `parallelGitLimit` (180 s), not `GitProcess.defaultTimeLimit`.
+- [x] `swift test` passes (1935 tests).
+- [ ] Push, and send the CI result to testudoapp-9a. #bug #test
\ No newline at end of file

+title: Remove the parallel git tests of the test helper GitProcess
 ---
-CI run 44343306842 (909c903, runner m3u1, 32 cores) failed in `GitProcessTests.sleepWakesWhileGitRuns` with `.timedOut`. The test starts 128 `sleep 5` git commands while the other suites run. The time limit of `GitProcess.run` starts before git starts, so it also counts the wait for a thread and the start of the process. Alone, the test passes in 5.3 s. This is a limit that is too tight under load, not a defect in `GitProcess`.
+CI run 44343306842 (909c903, runner m3u1, 32 cores) failed in `GitProcessTests.sleepWakesWhileGitRuns` with `.timedOut`. The test started 4 git commands for each processor (128 on m3u1) while the other suites ran.
+
+3054fe1 added the test when the product code ran git. Since 999274b the product code reads git with libgit2, and `GitProcess` is only a test helper. Thus the parallel tests protect no product behavior, and they make the CI runs slow and not reliable.

 ## Steps

-- [x] Push 7e301ba. CI run 44739384263: the job "Build & test" passes (tests and the nested integration build).
-- [ ] The job "Integration (opt-in, real dependencies)" passes. Then send the CI result to testudoapp-9a.
\ No newline at end of file
